purpose: Private Blender research toward the requested Crane Row enemy-model improvements; not a published release.

candidate.authoring: Blender 4.5.10 LTS; twenty added quads replace twenty older shoulder and wrist faces. tools/crane_blender.py reproduced this exact ROM hash and records the Blender version in its metadata.

interim_luna_review.scope: Ballast appearance only; reviewer could not play or hear the video. No full-roster or motion/audio approval.
interim_luna_review.code_review: No must-fix loss, rig, UV or output-safety finding. The reviewer requested Blender-version reporting and a ROM/sidecar test; both were added and the reviewer marked the finding resolved.

combat.result: Timed out after 6000 combat frames; all three species took damage, incoming player damage was observed, Ballast action 91 (get-up) was sampled, and up to five live actors appeared.
combat.fixtures: Copied save, healed player, native enemy HP and inputs. The labelled single-species Freight setup admitted a mixed roster after cargo delivery.

end_snapshot_heap2.limit: One end-of-timeout snapshot with three enemies; not peak crowd headroom or a controlled comparison.

death_control.result: One selected Ballast was set to 1 HP in disposable RAM at frame 643; its native HP reached zero at frame 656 after a hit. The mixed route did not clear.
death_control.limit: This establishes an observed lethal hit under the fixture, not normal-HP clearability or presentation quality.

reward_fixture_attempts: work/crane-row/rework/reward-ballast-native-b5-5f011cbe.json: no spawn while the driver waited at the entrance
work/crane-row/rework/reward-ballast-native-b5walk-5f011cbe.json: native approach saw an enemy, but the driver exited the room and no Ballast death was sampled
open: Review the first enemy's normal-speed motion and mixed audio; neither available reviewer could play or hear the clip.
Improve and independently review Maw and Spore only after the first example qualifies.
Qualify the final composition and achieve a Luna score of at least 8/10 for the requested work before publication.
Player feedback, hardware presentation, VRAM and peak-crowd heap headroom are unconfirmed.
